description: A comprehensive MongoDB library for .NET featuring database migrations, distributed locking, message queues, and database configurators with built-in support for dependency injection.
releaseNotes:
# v1.0.0-rc.2 (2026-11-22)

### 💥 Breaking Changes

- Trim and rename the remaining public API before 1.0, allow record payloads and reject duplicate outbox discriminators (#305) by @chA0s-Chris
- Retry outbox messages indefinitely instead of dropping them after a short outage (#279) by @chA0s-Chris
- Make tamper-evidence verification results report what was actually proven (#275) by @chA0s-Chris
- Count every queue and outbox delivery attempt, not only handler failures (#277) by @chA0s-Chris
- Make default MongoDB collection names stable and collision-free (#272) by @chA0s-Chris
- Keep persisted field names and the queue processing index stable across BSON conventions (#269) by @chA0s-Chris
- Make distributed lock release reliable after a cancelled renewal (#268) by @chA0s-Chris
- Standardize queue duration metrics to seconds and expand the compatibility policy (#267) by @chA0s-Chris
- Wait for the migration lock, renew it, and reject duplicate IDs (#264) by @chA0s-Chris
- Configure the integrity collection names with a prefix (#228) by @chA0s-Chris
- Align outbox and queue option names (#227) by @chA0s-Chris
- Trim the EventStore public API and reshape the integrity types (#226) by @chA0s-Chris
- Trim the public API of Chaos.Mongo (#225) by @chA0s-Chris
- Trim the Outbox public API (#224) by @chA0s-Chris
- Target net10.0 only and lower dependency minimums (#222) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add IServiceProvider-aware AddMongo overloads and MongoBuilder.ConfigureOptions (#195) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix event store dropping members inherited from intermediate base classes (#187) by @chA0s-Chris
- Separate stream position from aggregate revision with store-assigned versions, revision-based concurrency, GetAtRevisionAsync and observational events (#166) by @chA0s-Chris

### ✨ Features

- Enforce the certificate policy on every timestamp chain link and refuse to seal events of unregistered types (#302) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add outbox metrics for published, failed and terminally failed messages, publish duration and message age (#292) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add net11.0 as a target framework alongside net10.0 (#291) by @chA0s-Chris
- Name the outbox in processor warning messages (#284) by @chA0s-Chris
- Resolve queue payload handlers in a per-item DI scope (#229) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add tamper-evidence verification to the event store with a stable, independently verifiable format (#200) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add IServiceProvider-based publisher factory to the transactional outbox (#197) by @chA0s-Chris
- Confirm TSA revocation status with CRLs issued after the token time (#190) by @chA0s-Chris
- Store timestamp evidence of tamper-evidence anchors once, so large CRLs no longer stall anchoring (#191) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix corrected event store registrations failing until restart after a rejected configuration (#189) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add transactional erasure of personal data from sealed events to the event store (#184) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add integrity anchoring with RFC 3161 timestamp authorities to the event store (#172) by @chA0s-Chris
- Track changed event streams for tamper-evidence anchoring (#170) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add tamper-evident per-stream hash chains to the event store (#161) by @chA0s-Chris

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Make overlapping stops safe for outbox, queue, sealing and anchoring components (#319) by @chA0s-Chris
- Keep the first notification time when several instances notify the same integrity anchor (#316) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix migrations continuing after the migration lock's lease was lost (#315) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix class map registration failing when hosts are built concurrently, and speed up the test suite (#296) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix idle polling and misleading lock-recovery/standalone signals in MongoDB queues (#283) by @chA0s-Chris
- Skip malformed event documents so anchoring and sealing keep running (#270) by @chA0s-Chris
- Stop timestamp verification from fetching certificate URLs embedded in stored data (#266) by @chA0s-Chris
- Report event store append failures with the correct exception (#265) by @chA0s-Chris
- Stop queue handler timeouts from being treated as shutdown signals (#263) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix broken index renames and concurrent-startup races in index creation (#262) by @chA0s-Chris
- Prevent outbox batch failures for IAsyncDisposable-only publishers (#261) by @chA0s-Chris
- Prevent duplicate event versions when the concurrency index is missing (#260) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix ObjectDisposedException when MongoQueue is disposed more than once (#259) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix published outbox messages staying pending when the processor stops (#178) by @chA0s-Chris

### 📚 Documentation

- Correct the 0.x migration guide and document event evolution, collection names and a production checklist (#306) by @chA0s-Chris
- Complete the 1.0 reference documentation and add a testing guide (#233) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add 1.0 upgrade guide, compatibility policy and requirements (#232) by @chA0s-Chris
